rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or thing that is of no use or value.

example.english: This old umbrella is worthless now, so just throw it away.
example.traditional: 呢把舊傘已經冇用，掉咗佢啦。
example.jyutping: ne1 baa2 gau6 saan3 ji5 ging1 mou5 jung6 diu6 zo2 keoi5 laa1

rows.note: Use this colloquial insult specifically for a useless, incompetent person rather than an object.

example.english: They can't even handle something so simple; they are worthless.
example.traditional: 佢連咁簡單嘅嘢都做唔掂，真係廢柴。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lin4 gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 zou6 m4 dim6 zan1 hai6 fai3 caai4

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something lacks value, especially an idea, contribution, or object, rather than simply being ineffective.

example.english: This proposal is worthless to the company, so there’s no need to discuss it further.
example.traditional: 呢個方案對公司冇價值，唔使再討論喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 deoi3 gung1 si1 mou5 gaa3 zik6 m4 sai2 zoi3 tou2 leon6 laa3
